text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple probes reporting packet loss and latency spike from our us-west-2 edge to public prefixes. Severity: P1. Alert rule: network.packet_loss > 5% for 2m. Auto-page sent to #incidents, @net-oncall, and @oncall-sre.
Sam Chen: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Pulling BGP/RIB and edge hw stats now.
Anya Patel: seeing 20-40% packet loss from our edge->customer hosts (tcp retransmits up). Metrics: host.egress_loss.us-west-2 increased at 21:03 UTC.
Michael O'Neill: running quick checks — netflow shows sudden path shift to ASN 64555 (ZephyrNet). Looks like we started preferring Zephyr for a subset of prefixes.
Sam Chen: can we get a traceroute to one of the affected IPs? 198.51.100.12 is failing for multiple customers.
Anya Patel: traceroute output:
```
traceroute to 198.51.100.12 (198.51.100.12), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.10.8.1  0.8 ms  0.7 ms  0.7 ms
 2  203.0.113.1  1.9 ms  2.0 ms  1.8 ms
 3  * * *
 4  198.51.200.45 (198.51.200.45)  30.2 ms  33.9 ms  29.7 ms
 5  198.51.100.12  31.1 ms  29.8 ms  30.6 ms
```
But sometimes hops 3-4 drop, intermittent.
Sam Chen: flipping to BGP view — here's the relevant prefix adjs from our edge (abbreviated):
```
show ip bgp 198.51.100.0/24 longer-prefixes
  * 198.51.100.0/24 64555 64520 65001 i (via 203.0.113.5) 21:04:02, suppressed
  > 198.51.100.0/24 64520 65001 i (via 203.0.113.9) 21:03:58
```
We have multiple AS paths, a route via Zephyr (64555) with odd next-hop flips.
noc-zephyr: We're seeing neighbor flaps on our peering session to Redwood edge at 21:02 UTC — RIB churn and intermittent withdraws. Our NOC is investigating a fabric BGP controller process restart that correlates with the timing.
Michael O'Neill: BGP update rate on that session: 400 updates/minute at peak. Also observed community tags being stripped on some announcements which may be causing our local prefs to flip.
Kate Morris: Quick mitigation plan: 1) prefer backup upstream (Asteria Transit ASN 64444) for affected prefixes by adjusting localpref on our border for the short term. 2) request Zephyr to suppress flaps or take problematic PoPs offline. 3) enable blackhole+redirect only if packet loss persists.
Sam Chen: I'm going to program a temporary BGP policy to prefer Asteria for the 198.51.100.0/24 block. Pushing now via automation.
ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered: bgp-policy-update job #8745 started by Sam Chen. See https://ci.internal/jobs/8745
Sam Chen: pushed. Confirming RIB now...
Michael O'Neill: RIB shows preferred path moved to ASN 64444 via 203.0.114.2. Update rate down to ~30 updates/min. Packet loss reduced to ~3% within 90s.
Anya Patel: still seeing intermittent TCP timeouts for a small subset of customers who have pinned routes through Zephyr POPs — estimated 1-2% customer impact. Customer Success: pinging enterprise customers (esp. AcmeCorp and Finxi) now.
sam chen: tagging @noc-zephyr — can you confirm root cause? any ongoing fabric restarts?
noc-zephyr: Confirmed: fabric controller had a bug triggered by an internal config push; we're isolating the affected spine cluster and rolling back. Expected stabilization in ~30-45m. We'll send a postmortem note.
Kate Morris: Good. Actions pending for next 30m: - monitor for BGP flaps - keep Asteria preference until Zephyr stable - update status page if impact > 5% or SLA-bound customers affected - prepare rollback plan to normal routing after 30m observation window.
Sam Chen: Noting customer impact numbers: peak error budget burn estimated 12% for one enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) — engineering & CS notified.
Michael O'Neill: Added a temporary prefix-level dampening on the session to suppress frequent flaps (dampening configured: reuse 750, suppress 2000, max suppress 600s).
Anya Patel: confirmed latency metrics trending back to baseline for most flows. Still monitoring Cloud NAT retransmits for private deployments.
ops-bot: incident-bot updated severity: P1 -> P2 at 21:18 UTC based on impact reduction. :white_check_mark:
Sam Chen: Handoff to Kate Morris for the 21:20->23:00 on-call window. Kate, please own rollback once Zephyr confirms stable.
Kate Morris: Taking handoff. My plan: 1) watch BGP update rate and RIB for 30m, 2) coordinate with NOC for confirmation of fix, 3) when stable for 15m, slowly remove localpref override and monitor. I'll post each step.
incident-bot: Page sent to #customer-success and #support to prepare customer comms drafts.
Michael O'Neill: save logs: /var/log/network/bgpd/updates-2102504321.log (snippet attached in thread).
Sam Chen: note for postmortem: timeline, root cause = Zephyr fabric controller config push, our mitigation = temporary localpref->Asteria + dampening; residual customer impact limited but non-zero.
ops-bot: Reminder: owner must create a postmortem ticket and link to this thread. Suggested tags: networking, bgp, zephyrnet, mitigation, routed-failover.
Kate Morris: Will open the postmortem ticket after final verification. Current status: monitoring, no new withdrawals for 12m. Keeping thread open. :eyes:
